scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for every positive momentum; symbolic witness is supporting and not a proof of universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Only a two-rail Kirchhoff ladder with equal rail lengths and two transverse edges; describes eigenvalue positions, not gaps or density of states. Strongest comparison is to the equal-edge magnetic tube. Transfer-matrix equivalents under other terminology remain a literature risk.
title: Positive flat-band classification for an unequal-edge magnetic tubular ladder
